purpose: Derive observable human coordination cost from durable events without inventing presence, effort, timestamps or external-chat duration, and expose deterministic fields reusable by scale-readiness and Primary Chat.
authority_boundary: This contract derives metrics only. It creates no scheduler, liveness owner, CURRENT, telemetry authority, acceptance authority or human-presence inference.

HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED.meaning: An existing machine owner durably states that further machine progress depends on one specific human action.
HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED.law: Human inactivity alone MUST NOT create this event.

HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED.meaning: An existing durable ingress/approval/action owner records an actual human action.
HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED.law: Only this event advances last_human_action_at. Worker signals never do.

boundary_cleared.meaning: The machine no longer requires the previously declared human action, without claiming that the human acted.

EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED.meaning: Relevant interaction occurred outside a durable interval owner or lacks a durable start/end pair.
EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED.law: Its quantitative duration is null, never guessed.

WORKER_SIGNAL.meaning: Beacon, claim, STARTED, heartbeat, RETURN or equivalent durable worker signal projected for comparison.
WORKER_SIGNAL.law: It may update last_worker_signal_at but never last_human_action_at and never clears a human boundary unless a separate boundary_cleared event exists.

derived_metrics.human_round_trips: Count of explicit HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED boundaries closed by HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED.
derived_metrics.avoidable_human_handoffs: Count of HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED events classified AVOIDABLE_HUMAN_HANDOFF.
derived_metrics.unavoidable_human_gates: Count of HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED events classified NECESSARY_HUMAN_GATE.
derived_metrics.human_boundary_wait_ms: Sum of completed explicit human-boundary intervals with observable endpoints.
derived_metrics.human_action_wait_ms: Subset of human_boundary_wait_ms whose close event is HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED.
derived_metrics.human_idle_ms: Elapsed time since last durable HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED when as_of is known; informational only and never itself a bottleneck.
derived_metrics.external_unobserved_duration_ms: Always null because external unobserved interval duration is not inferable.

fixtures_prove: worker signals do not reset the human clock
human silence without explicit HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED is not a bottleneck
machine-cleared avoidable handoff is timed without claiming a human action
external chat without durable endpoints remains EXTERNAL_UNOBSERVED with null duration
truth_boundary: Only durable observable endpoints may become quantitative time. Wall-clock silence, physical presence, private external-chat timing and human effort are not inferred.
